parent_objective: critical-window history-necessity task or gate design

public_gates: treat M480 late-one-shot rows as margin-only source-narrow timing evidence
do not count clamped wrong_hold rows as deployable proof
design a shorter or more critical emergency-window task/gate

forbidden_shortcuts: do not add privileged actor inputs
do not claim margin-only source-narrow late-once rows as deployable proof

hypothesis: Because late one-shot wrong history creates only margin-only source-narrow degradation while clamped hold variants create event rows, the next useful test is a critical-window task or gate that reduces recovery time after a natural wrong-history perturbation.
success_criteria: document why M480 did not pass the natural-late proof gate
define a critical-window task or gate family that shortens the recovery horizon after wrong-history injection
define diagnostic variants and thresholds before implementation
preserve the P0 human-view actor-input contract

commands.name: critical_window_design
commands.command: Use M480 artifacts to design a shorter emergency-window history-necessity diagnostic; no training.

decision_rule: M481 should decide the next diagnostic design only after preserving the distinction between clamped diagnostic evidence and natural late-one-shot proof.
